contexts.text: So that in the other life (their mind) can scarcely be restored.
Restitution (, etc.). Treated of.
Thus (the antediluvians) became such that they could not be restored. (That is, regenerated. AC 933:end.)
Thus (by the capability of being regenerated as to the intellectual part) man has been restored.
The internal Church perverted... and restored. Treated of.
The time and state of restoration. Signified. AC 1856.
When internal worship is restored.
The restoration of the spiritual. Treated of.
That (interior truth) should be altogether restored to the Church. Signified.
The perversion... and restoration of the truth of the Church. Treated of.
What is the penalty, and what the restoration. Treated of.
Restoration by interpretation. Signified, Explained. AC 9032:end.
That the internal man shall restore it to the full. Signified.
Restoration to entirety. Signified.

Five = the restoration of exterior good to what is much; and four, the restoration of interior good to the full. The reason interior good is to be restored to the full, is that this good makes man's spiritual life; and, unless his spiritual life is restored to the full, exterior good, which makes the natural life, cannot be restored; for the latter life is restored through the former... But the good in the Natural cannot be restored to the full...
Injuries inflicted on the truth of faith and good of charity, and their amendment and restoration. Treated of. AC 9130.
If anything of good and truth is left through which it can be restored. Signified, Explained.
Restoration to the full. Signified. AC 9152. (Compare AC 9161.)
Restoration from goods and truths still uninjured. Signified.
Restoration of the things taken away through anger... Signified.
The loss of the truth of faith... thus of spiritual life, and its restoration. Treated of.
The restoration of truth to good, in place of that taken away. Signified.
If the good of truth be there together, there shall be no restoration. Signified.
That scientific truths which have disappeared through fallacies are to be restored before there is a state of shade from the delights of external loves. Signified, Explained. AC 9213:2.
The plenary restoration of good and truth in the Church. Signified.
Restoration by the Divine truth proceeding from the Divine Human. Signified.
This is not restored in the descendants except by shunning evils as sins.
See Restore.
Like a just king who... restores the spoil to his subjects.
The restoration of the garden to its state of efflorescence...
I returned the paper.
He said he would restore (the things stolen)... I said that he ought to restore them.
The other part (of the mind) which was restored, is now destroyed in them.
If (these Spirits) were removed, man would be at once restored.
(The diseased) pray that they may be restored, and say that they have been restored by God.
The restoration of the Church. Treated of.
To restore the earth () = to restore restaurare-the Church. That the Lord has not restored the earth to the Jewish people, is known. AE 701:6.
Then the Lord intensifies his power from the Sun... to restore the state which is labouring.
His flesh was restored () = the spiritual life such as it is in those who are being regenerated...
The restoration and instauration of a new Church, called the Ancient Church...
